steps.why: Aerial duel tackle won by a player late in the game, showing defensive effort.

steps.text: Lima wins the aerial duel against Weber! Rating up to 8.3!
¡Lima gana el duelo aéreo contra Weber y sube a 8.3!

steps.why: G. Lima scored a crucial 89th-minute goal assisted by M. Thomas, shifting the score to 3-2.

steps.text: Gooooal! Lima nets it for Azure City, 3-2 and rating rockets to 8.9!
¡Gooool de Lima para Azure City, 3-2 y su rating sube a 8.9!

steps.why: The team and fans react to the late goal by G. Lima, increasing anticipation for the match outcome.

steps.text: He wheels away to celebrate. What a moment for Lima and Azure City!
¡Lima celebra con todo, qué momento para Azure City!
